title: 3pl Management Senior Manager
description: About Us Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world. What You'll Do 1.Developing 3pl partners and expanding the number of partners and riders according to the demand for delivery in each city. 2.Enhance partners' operational capabilities through training and communication, so that partners better understand our company rules and strategies. 3.Build and maintain strong relationships with all 3PL partners across the region 4.Ensure 100% compliance for 3PL partners and their riders 5.Work closely with product teams to optimize the processes and products used by 3PL companies 6.Work with the operations team to develop rewards and penalties for 3PL and manage them on a day-to-day basis to achieve business goals such as hiring goals, user experience goals, etc. 7. Take responsibility for the partners and regions to achieve rider recruitment, operations, management, and user experience goals. 8. Communicate the elimination of partners who do not meet the requirements. 9. Complete the related work within the department assigned by the manager. What We Need From You 1. Bachelor degree or above is preferred, experience related in areas as rider growth and partner Management 2. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong partner relationships 3. Strong negotiation and problem-solving abilities, with a results-oriented mindset 4. In-depth knowledge of the rider, 3pl market trends and best practices 5. Proficiency in English is required. 6. Experience in managing partners for large corporations, and be able to independently take charge of partner management or the formulation and implementation of business strategies. 7. Experience in managing food delivery partners preferred, or in managing and analyzing partners for large domestic logistics or express delivery companies. Why Join Keeta Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career. As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond. Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

-Experiência por 5 anos ou mais como Advogado na área de contratos no ramo de empresas/coorporativo vai ser contado como diferencial;
-Dominar o pacote office, especialmente as funcionalidades do Word e Excel;
-Familiaridadecom LGPD e demais normas aplicáveis a dados pessoais. Diferencial: -Ter experiência com empresas do ramo educacional;
-Ter experiência em softwares jurídicos para gestão de contratos, em especial o projuris;

Faça parte da história da UNICID! Você está pronto para contribuir com o nosso propósito de educação de qualidade e excelência? Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Com 50 anos de história, somos referência na formação de profissionais da área da saúde, com cursos tradicionais e pioneiros na região, e também em pesquisa por meio de nossos conceituados Programas de Mestrado e Doutorado, recomendados pela Capes, e possuímos forte DNA em internacionalização. Além além de ser cada vez mais reconhecida nas demais áreas do conhecimento, com um portfolio completo de cursos de graduação presencial e a distância, pós-graduação, extensão e programas de parcerias no Brasil e no exterior. Conectamos alunos, docentes, colaboradores, metodologias, comunidade e o mercado de trabalho, para proporcionar a melhor experiência na formação superior, guiando e orientando o universitário durante toda sua jornada acadêmica, transformando assim vidas e realidades por meio da educação. Fazemos parte da Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S/A, um dos maiores e mais representativos grupos de educação do País que reúne instituições de ensino superior academicamente relevantes e marcas reconhecidas em seus respectivos mercados. title: Senior Amlo
description:
Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior AMLO to oversee the company’s global AML framework, with primary responsibility for Brazil. The role covers regulatory obligations under BCB, COAF, CVM, and frameworks for electronic money issuers, payment institutions, and related sectors. You will serve as the main regulatory contact and designated MLRO for Brazil. Key Responsibilities: Lead the AML/CTF programme for Brazil, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations (BCB, COAF, CVM, PIX, EMI/payment frameworks). Act as the official MLRO for Brazilian operations and support regulatory expectations in other jurisdictions as needed. Develop and maintain AML/CTF policies, KYC/CDD/EDD standards, and ongoing monitoring frameworks tailored to Brazilian requirements (CPF, CNPJ, beneficial ownership rules). Implement governance aligned with BCB/COAF/CVM supervisory standards. Conduct AML risk assessments and manage monitoring systems for transaction surveillance, sanctions/PEP screening, and detection of local typologies (e.G., PIX fraud). Ensure timely COAF reporting and all mandatory filings for payment institutions. Maintain proper audit trails and records under Brazilian retention standards. Serve as the primary contact for BCB, COAF, and CVM for AML-related matters. Deliver AML/CTF training covering Brazilian typologies, COAF red flags, and sector-specific risks. Ensure compliance with LGPD and manage cross-border data transfers lawfully. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, or related field;
Master’s preferred. 10+ years of AML/CTF experience with deep knowledge of Brazilian AML laws and regulatory frameworks. Proven experience in AML leadership within payment institutions, EMI, fintech, or regulated financial environments operating across multiple jurisdictions. Strong understanding of Brazilian PEP rules, ownership verification, PIX risk patterns, and reporting systems (SISCOAF, BCB platforms). Excellent communication skills and experience working directly with Brazilian regulators. Vision & Mission: OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Engenheiro De Dados
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias. Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidade s, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde. Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente? O que nos move todos os dias? Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo. O Engenheiro (a) de dados Sênior será responsável por: Projetar e implementar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados em larga escala, utilizando ferramentas em cloud (AWS/Azure Databricks);
Garantir a integridade, qualidade, governança e segurança dos dados;
Trabalhar próximo ao time de Data Science, Analytics e demais áreas para garantir que os dados estejam prontos para consumo;
Automatizar processosde integração e tratamento de dados;
Implementar práticas de monitoramento de pipelines de dados e tratamento de falhas;
Apoiar na escolha e implantação de ferramentas de dados (ETL, orquestração, versionamento, etc.). Atuar na ingestão e modelagem de dados;
Contribuir para a construção de uma cultura orientada a dados;
Garantir compliance com regulamentações de proteção de dados (LGPD, GDPR, etc.). Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit: Experiência consolidada (mínimo 4 anos) na área de Engenharia de Dados lidando com AWS e Azure Databricks;
Sólidos conhecimentosem construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados utilizando Airflow, Python, PySpark, EMR, AWS Glue, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, AWS Athena e similares;
Domínio de SQL;
Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e arquivos colunares (como parquet);
Conhecimento em versionamento de código (Git) e CI/CD para pipelines de dados;
Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade de dados;
Familiaridadecom conceitos de DataOps e MLOps é um diferencial importante;
Noções de segurança da informação aplicadas a dados;
Diferencial Inglês técnico e noções de espanhol. Modelo de contratação PJ.

title: Desenvolvedor De Produtos
description: About the Company Hi, we're Actabl. We're providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together. Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted. Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out. Key Responsibilities: Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery. Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions. Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows. Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions. Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc. Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward. Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams. Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality. Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD. You as a Product Designer Ideal Profile You are not a "by the books" Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams. 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies. Portuguese and English is mandatory Living in Brazil. Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions. Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers) Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications. Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces. Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries). Strong craft with an attention to detail. Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.' Nice to Have Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.G., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code). Experience integrating AI into design workflows. Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows. Work Environment: Location: Full-remote Brasil. Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup. Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals). Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs About AnswerThis AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes. Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery. If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it. The Role We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI. You will: Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems. Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests. Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems. Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration. Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads. Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide. Requirements Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval. Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services. Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models. Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests. Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability. A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes. Compensation $20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside. How to Apply Send the following to Subject: AI Engineer Application Include: Your resume. Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines. A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis. Applications without these will not be considered. Let us build the future of research together.

Experiência/ Conhecimento com Operação e Manutenção, Automação e Instrumentação e/ou Mecânica. Local de Trabalho Camaçari - BA - Brasil

title: Risk Expert
description:
About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
Net-worth monitoring.Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.Requirements:Legally resident in Brazil.Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred.Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency in Portuguese and English.Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description:
A Logicalis valoriza a diversidade, oferecendo iguais oportunidades a todos os candidatos qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica. Somos #ArchitectsOfChange. Ajudamos milhares de empresas a se transformarem e terem sucesso em um mundo digital. Acreditamos que a tecnologia pode mudar o mundo e torná-lo um lugar melhor para viver promovendo uma cultura alinhada aos nossos valores: integridade, inovação, excelência, parcerias e empoderamento Sobre a oportunidade: Estamos em busca de um Especialista Sênior em Redes Wireless (Wi-Fi) com profundo domínio em projetos de alta complexidade, para atuar na arquitetura, implementação e suporte de soluções avançadas de conectividade sem fio em ambientes corporativos, industriais e de alta densidade. O profissional será referência técnica no tema, participando de projetos estratégicos de modernização de infraestrutura, integração com redes cabeadas, soluções de segurança e monitoramento, além de atuar em iniciativas de inovação e automação. Será responsável ainda no desenvolvimento dos profissionais juniores do time. Veja como será o seu dia a dia: Liderar o desenho e implementação de soluções Wi-Fi corporativas e mission-critical;
Realizar surveys e site surveys (físicos e preditivos) com ferramentas como Ekahau;
Propor arquiteturas wireless de alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança (WLC, APs, roaming, RRM, CleanAir, etc.);
Participar da definição de políticas de autenticação (802.1X, Radius, ISE) e segmentação de rede (SDA, SGT, VLANs);
Elaborar HLDs, LLDs, planos de teste e documentação técnica em português e inglês;
Realizar troubleshooting avançado e atuação em ambientes críticos (hospitais, universidades, indústrias, grandes eventos, etc.);
Trabalhar com ferramentas de visibilidade, tuning e segurança Wi-Fi (DNA Center, Prime, CleanAir, Spectrum Analysis);
Atuar em conjunto comtimes de redes LAN, segurança e cloud para garantir integração fim a fim. O que você precisa para ocupar esta vaga? Vasta experiência com redes Wi-Fi corporativas ;
Experiência comprovada com controladoras Cisco (WLC), APs (Catalyst, Aironet), e soluções Cisco Wireless LAN;
Certificação ativa Cisco CCIE Wireless ;
Domínio de protocolose tecnologias wireless (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax, DFS, OFDMA, MU-MIMO, Fast Roaming);
Conhecimentos em segurança wireless (WPA2/3, 802.1X, EAP, PSK, ACLs, NAC) ;
Experiência com DNA Center, Cisco Prime, ISE e soluções SD-Access Wireless;
Inglês avançado para documentação e reuniões com fabricantes. Diferencial: Experiência com Wi-Fi em ambientes críticos ou de alta densidade (healthcare, educação, logística, eventos, etc.);
Familiaridade com automação de redes (Ansible, Python, APIs do DNA Center);
Certificações adicionais: CWNA/CWNP, DevNet, ITIL, AWS/Azure Fundamentals;
Experiência com ferramentas de survey como Ekahau Site Survey Pro ou AirMagnet. Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido 2x na semana;

title: Risk Expert
description:

We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
Net-worth monitoring.Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.Requirements:Legally resident in Brazil.Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred.Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency in Portuguese and English.Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
IMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems. Role Responsibilities: Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts). Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety. Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses. Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs. Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team. Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines. Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks. Skills & Competencies: Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities. Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity. Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above);
additional languages aplus. Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems. Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently. Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs. Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks. Requirements: Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.). Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus. While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility. What We Offer: Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems. Innovative and supportive global working environment. Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements. Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation. Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

Fechamento do caixa, através de conferência da tesouraria. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Ensino médio concluído;
Excel básico;
Disponibilidade para atuar em horário comercial. SERÁ CONSIDERADO UM DIFERENCIAL: Experiência no sistema CORP;

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
About the Job TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S.
-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel. We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries. Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization. Joining our team you will be focusing on Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings. Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams. Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues. Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs. Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams. Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region. Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc. Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date. Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment. Required Skills A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus Client-facing experience Advanced level of English Great interpersonal and influencing skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Experience with HRIS Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload Good level of emotional intelligence Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized Attention to detail and high level of accuracy Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments Learning agility Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload Personal competencies Growth Mindset Proactive and enthusiastic Cultural Competence Initiative and creativity Achievement drive and optimism Can-do attitude Interpersonal and Communication Skills Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills Why You Should Work at TurnKey We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule Provided laptop (MacBooks) Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget Private health & dental insurance Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year Fully Remote work Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Ps Systems Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior System Engineer III to join our Enterprise Monitoring team. In this role, you will be critical to the daily operations, maintenance, and optimization of our observability platforms— Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic —and will also support day-to-day ticketing and incident response workflows. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with a passion for automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities: Own the daily health, performance, and availability of enterprise monitoring tools (Splunk, DynaTrace, NewRelic). Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and configuration tuning to ensure optimal system performance. Triage and resolve monitoring-related incidents and service tickets in a timely and efficient manner. Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to integrate monitoring solutions and improve visibility. Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and reports to support operational and business needs. Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response efforts. Document operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles. Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability. Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or enterprise monitoring roles. Hands-on experience with Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic in production environments. Strong understanding of IT operations, incident management, and ticketing systems (e.G., ServiceNow, Jira). Proficiency in scripting languages (e.G., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and tool integration. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker). Excellent troubleshooting skills and a bias for action in high-pressure situations. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English;
Portuguese is a plus. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working in a global or distributed team. Knowledge of ITIL practices and observability maturity models. Certifications in Splunk, DynaTrace, or NewRelic are a plus.

title: Gerente De Contas Marketplace
description: O Magalu é uma das maiores empresas de varejo do Brasil, reconhecida por sua inovação e presença digital. Com mais de 60 anos de história, conecta milhões de clientes por meio das lojas e de uma plataforma multicanal, oferecendo produtos e serviços de qualidade. A empresa investe continuamente em transformação digital, tecnologia e diversidade, criando um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Contas para integrar nossa equipe, atuando como um parceiro estratégico focado no desenvolvimento contínuo e na aceleração dos nossos sellers. Procuramos um profissional com perfil consultivo, excelente capacidade de negociação e visão analítica para transformar dados de performance em planos de ação. Se você é movido por resultados, tem facilidade em construir relacionamentos sólidos e sabe identificar oportunidades de crescimento dentro de um ecossistema digital, esta oportunidade é para você! Como será seu dia dia: Como nosso novo Gerente de Contas, seu principal objetivo será garantir o crescimento sustentável e a máxima rentabilidade da sua carteira de sellers. Você atuará como uma ponte entre o parceiro e as áreas internas, assegurando que o seller utilize todo o potencial do nosso ecossistema. Planejamento e Acompanhamento Estratégico: Conduzir reuniões periódicas com os sellers para alinhamento de metas e estratégias. Você será responsável por monitorar os principais KPIs (vendas, rentabilidade, visitas, reputação, adesão ao fulfillment, sortimento de catálogo e adesão a campanhas), estruturar planos de crescimento e fornecer insights valiosos baseados em dados para otimizar a operação da loja. Gestão Comercial e Engajamento em Campanhas: Garantir a participação ativa dos sellers no calendário promocional, negociando condições comerciais e ações conjuntas que aumentem a visibilidade e a competitividade da carteira. Consultoria de Performance e Ecossistema: Incentivar e orientar a adesão às ferramentas do ecossistema (Magalu Ads, Magalu Entregas, etc.) como alavancas de sucesso. Você deverá identificar oportunidades de expansão de sortimento, otimização de anúncios e atuar preventivamente para evitar rupturas de estoque. Gestão de Relacionamento e Reputação: Atuar como o ponto focal estratégico do seller, facilitando a resolução de questões junto às áreas internas e orientando sobre as melhores práticas para manter um alto nível de serviço e reputação na plataforma. Requisitos: Graduação completa em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida e comprovada em Gestão de Contas (Farmer), Relacionamento B2B ou Vendas Consultivas. Habilidade analítica para interpretar indicadores de performance (KPIs de vendas) e transformá-los em planos de ação. Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar os tomadores de decisão. Visão sistêmica para entender o ciclo de vendas no marketplace e as dores do seller. Ser uma pessoa organizada e proativa, capaz de gerenciar uma carteira com múltiplos parceiros simultaneamente. Domínio intermediário/avançado de Excel/Google Sheets e elaboração de apresentações Diferenciais Experiência prévia em e-commerce ou marketplace. Conhecimento em ferramentas de Mídia/Ads e Logística para e-commerce. Vivência com análise de dados (SQL e BigQuery) e ferramentas de BI. Benefícios que oferecemos: VR/VA, Vale Transporte, Assistência Médica e Odontológica e Auxílio Creche. Gympass para bem-estar e saúde. Bolsa de estudo com até 50% de desconto. Descontos especiais nas empresas do Grupo Magalu (Netshoes, Época Cosméticos, Estante Virtual, Kabum). Cheque mãe benefício exclusivo para mães com filhos de até 10 anos e 11 meses - Cheque Educação especial benefício exclusivo para mães e pais que possuam filhos com deficiência. Modelo de Trabalho Adotamos o modelo híbrido de trabalho, que une a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto à interação presencial no escritório, oferecendo um equilíbrio entre as diferentes formas de colaboração e bem-estar. ‘’Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento e desafios, Vem ser feliz’’!

title: Full-Time Software Development Engineer, São Paulo
description: About the Team/Role WEX is seeking a Software Development Engineer 3 (Full Stack) to join our Health & Benefits Platform technology team.In this role, you will design, build, and deliver scalable microservices and modern web applications that power our next-generation benefits experience.You’ll be a senior-level contributor collaborating across teams to build event-driven systems, reusable frameworks, and user-focused solutions using C# .NET, Kafka, and React within a microservice architecture deployed to the cloud. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of complex features spanning backend and frontend components. Apply deep technical expertise to design and implement clean, maintainable, and performant code. Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to team design standards. Partner with architects and product managers to define scalable solutions aligned with the platform’s long-term strategy. Ensure that code quality, observability, and maintainability are embedded throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Design and develop C# .NET Core microservices that support domain-driven architecture. Build and maintain React front-end applications integrated with REST and GraphQL APIs. Implement and consume Kafka event streams to enable reliable, asynchronous communication across services. Contribute to API design, versioning, and documentation to ensure consistency across the ecosystem. Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions, and agile ceremonies. Ensure high quality through unit, integration, and contract testing. Partner with DevOps and QA to maintain CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and telemetry for production systems. Support incident resolution through effective root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. Share knowledge, promote best practices, and help evolve WEX’s engineering standards. Experience you'll bring Expertise in C# .NET Core, RESTful API development, and service design. Strong understanding of microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and distributed systems design. Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. Strong problem-solving, debugging, and collaboration skills. Effective written and spoken English communication. Plus Strong professional software engineering experience. Experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event streaming technologies. Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA). Familiarity with GraphQL federation (e.G., HotChocolate, Apollo Gateway). Exposure to Azure or other cloud environments. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, or similar observability tools. Previous experience in health, benefits, or financial services industries. Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and mentor other engineers.

title: Arquiteto De Software (React Native)
description:
Arquiteto de Software (React Native)A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a RethinkSomos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e InclusãoPara repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel?Como Arquiteto de Software, você será responsável por garantir que boas práticas de arquitetura sejam adotadas pelos times de desenvolvimento nos projetos e por criar visões arquiteturais que traduzam necessidades de negócio. Atuará também na comunicação da solução de forma clara ao time técnico, tomando decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos tecnológicos e materializem os objetivos de negócio, sendo responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade nos projetos.Como será seu dia a dia?- Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de arquitetura nos projetos;
- Criar visões arquiteturais que comuniquem a solução de forma clara ao time de desenvolvimento;
- Traduzir necessidadesde negócio em decisões técnicas e estruturais;
- Tomar decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos;
- Implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade;
- Apoiar e orientar times de desenvolvimento em decisões arquiteturais;
- Assegurar que soluçõesrespeitem restrições e atendam atributos de qualidade;
- Atuar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares para garantir excelência técnica e experiência do usuário.Para esta vaga, é essencial:- Domínio em React Native (Hooks, Context API, TypeScript, Navigation, Animations, Performance Optimization);
- Experiência sólida comintegrações nativas Android (Java/Kotlin) e iOS (Swift/Objective-C) — criação e manutenção de bridges;
- Experiência com arquiteturas móveis modernas (Clean Architecture, MVI/MVVM, Redux, Flux ou similares);
- Conhecimento em CI/CDmobile (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, AppCenter, etc.);
- Vivência com integração contínua com BFFs / REST APIs;
- Forte domínio de modularização, code splitting e monorepos (ex: NX);
- Conhecimento em testesautomatizados mobile (Jest, Detox, E2E, Unit Tests);
- Experiência em publicação e distribuição (Google Play, App Store, TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution);
- Comunicação técnica clara e colaborativa com times multidisciplinares;
- Capacidade de mentorare influenciar decisões técnicas em múltiplos squads;
- Perfil investigativo ehands-on, com habilidade para diagnosticar e resolver gargalos complexos;
- Foco em excelência técnica, segurança e experiência do usuário.Você pode se destacar se:- Tiver experiência com React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules);
- Dominar conceitos de arquitetura escalável (DDD, Event-Driven, Hexagonal);
- Tiver experiência commicro frontends mobile ou arquitetura plugin-based;
- Possuir conhecimento em segurança mobile avançada (OWASP Mobile, App Attest, biometria, criptografia local);
- Tiver experiência comanálise de performance nativa (Systrace, Perfetto, Instruments).O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?Básico que a gente ama- Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office- Day-off no aniversário- Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers Saúde e bem-estar- Auxílio bem-estar mensal- Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)- Assistência odontológica- Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde- Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento- On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer- Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receberCarreira e desenvolvimento- Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills- Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuoComo funciona o nosso processo seletivo?1. Inscrição2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.3. Bate-papo com People4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.5. Entrevista técnica com liderança6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.7. Feedback final8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Requisitos Experiência prévia como Analista Tributário Pleno, com foco em tributos retidos. Domínio de Retidos Federais e ISS. Vivência com Reinf, DCTFWeb, GIS Online e ambientes municipais, especialmente Prefeitura de São Paulo. Capacidade de lidar com grande volume de notas fiscais e múltiplas competências. Perfil proativo, organizado, com autonomia e senso de dono. Disponibilidade para atuar em ritmo dinâmico e com prazos apertados. Conhecimento em SAP para extração de relatórios. Excel avançado (tratamento de volume, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, cruzamentos). Experiência com Hiperium e HFM. Diferenciais Experiência com operações envolvendo alto número de filiais. Vivência com integração e limpeza de backlog de notas fiscais. Conhecimento de rotinas de apuração em múltiplas prefeituras.

title: C++ / .Net Developer
description:

- Experience developing software with C, C++, Java, Python, or other scripting languages.

- Expert In elliptic curve cryptography, post-quantum cryptography, and differential privacy.
- Advanced English level. How we make your work (and your life) easier: 100% remote work (from anywhere). Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred Hardware and software setup for you to work from home. Flexible hours: create your own schedule. Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays. Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent. Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities. Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: It Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities： Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases. CCTV, access control systems, racks, and cabling). Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs. Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards. Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements. VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN;
and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS. Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.G. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools. Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses. Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements. Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams. Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Portuguese and English, for effective communication is preferred. Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.G. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.G. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Head Of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builder who’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required;
    Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you\ 're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Associate - Medical Science Liaison (Msl) Cardiometabolismo - Região Ne - Sede Salvador
description:
Posição MSL - preferência de sede: Salvador

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life‑changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

PROPÓSITO DO TRABALHO

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) é um profissional de medical affairs baseado no campo com profundo conhecimento sobre doenças e tratamentos específicos, produtos disponíveis e compostos em investigação (tanto na Lilly como competidores), assim como detalhado conhecimento sobre pesquisa, assuntos regulatórios e educação médica, além dos processos relacionados. A principal atividade do MSL é engajar especialistas (scientific experts) e outros na comunidade médica para entender pesquisa externa, necessidades clínicas, responder questões espontaneamente solicitadas e fomentar um diálogo científico de duas vias. Scientific Experts são indivíduos que são reconhecidos por sua expertise numa área específica e como tais, têm necessidades especiais relacionadas a informações aprofundadas e atualizadas porque eles desenvolvem e implementam pesquisas e educam colegas e estudantes. Provendo respostas e facilitando a comunicação científica entre a indústria e a comunidade de Scientific Experts, o MSL tem a oportunidade de melhorar os desfechos dos pacientes através da informação necessária que direciona importantes questões clínicas e científicas.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADESPrincipais Atividades de Engajamento com Scientific Experts
  • Responder às questões dos Scientific Experts.
  • Reunir, analisar e compartilhar insights clínicos e inteligência científica.
  • Desenvolver e executar iniciativas de educação médica continuada.
  • Facilitar oportunidades de pesquisa e de atividades de educação médica.
PERFIL DO TRABALHO
  • Graduação em curso da área da saúde requerida (Medicina, Biologia, Enfermagem, Fisioterapia, Biomedicina, Farmácia ou Nutrição).
  • Pós‑graduação como mestrado ou doutorado desejável.
  • Experiência prévia em cardiometabolismo desejável.
  • Experiência prévia como MSL, educador médico, ou em outra área da indústria farmacêutica serão diferenciais.
  • Proficiência em inglês (falado e escrito).
  • Importantes habilidades interpessoais, incluindo capacidade de engajar em relacionamentos profissionais, além de networking.
  • Curiosidade intelectual a respeito da área da ciência/ Medicina pela qual é responsável (Metabolismo).
  • Alta motivação e capacidade de compreender grande quantidade de conteúdo científico que então será comunicado de forma clara e concisa.
  • Habilidades de apresentação – Expertise em análise crítica de artigos científicos.
  • Atender necessidades de clientes em relação a informações complexas.
  • Manejar prioridades e projetos envolvendo múltiplas áreas.
  • Habilidade em trabalhar efetivamente e compartilhar informações com uma equipe.
  • Familiaridade com comunidade acadêmica, pesquisa clínica e educação médica.
OUTRAS INFORMAÇÕES
  • Necessidade de disponibilidade para viagens nacionais / domésticas.
  • Possuir CNH categoria B válida.
  • Mobilidade para fixar residência em Salvador.

Descrição e detalhes sobre a oportunidade

Sobre o Nosso Escritório : Somos um escritório de advocacia consolidado e em expansão, com forte atuação no Direito Previdenciário. Nosso compromisso é com a excelência jurídica, a inovação e o atendimento humanizado aos nossos clientes. Valorizamos profissionais proativos, dedicados e que buscam constante aprimoramento em sua trajetória.

Resumo da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Advogado(a) Associado(a) com no mínimo 2 anos de experiência prática comprovada em Direito Previdenciário para integrar nossa equipe. O profissional atuará ativamente na gestão de processos previdenciários, desde a fase administrativa até a judicial, com foco em resultados e na entrega de um serviço jurídico de alta qualidade. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para advogados que desejam autonomia, desenvolvimento contínuo e que se identificam com um modelo de trabalho pautado em produtividade e colaboração.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atividades
  • Peticionamento Estratégico : Elaboração e acompanhamento de petições iniciais, contestações, recursos, manifestações e outras peças processuais em todas as fases do processo previdenciário (administrativo e judicial).
  • Desenvolvimento de Teses Jurídicas : Pesquisa e construção de argumentos jurídicos sólidos e inovadores para defesa dos interesses dos clientes, com base na legislação e jurisprudência atualizada.
  • Pareceres e Consultoria : Confecção de pareceres jurídicos e realização de consultorias para clientes, apresentando soluções claras e estratégicas para suas demandas previdenciárias.
  • Atuação em Audiências : Representação dos clientes em audiências (conciliação, instrução e julgamento) perante o INSS e o Poder Judiciário.
  • Sustentação Oral : Realização de sustentações orais perante tribunais, quando necessário, para defender as teses desenvolvidas nos processos.
  • Atendimento ao Público : Recepção e atendimento direto aos clientes, compreendendo suas necessidades, prestando informações e orientações jurídicas de forma empática e didática.
  • Gestão de Processos : Acompanhamento do andamento processual, controle de prazos e organização da documentação dos casos.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Formação superior completa em Direito e inscrição ativa na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB).
  • Experiência mínima de 2 (dois) anos comprovada em Direito Previdenciário.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação previdenciária (Lei 8.213 / 91, Lei 8.212 / 91, INSS / PRES no 128 / 2022) e do Código de Processo Civil.
  • Familiaridade com a jurisprudência atualizada do STJ, STF, TNU e TRFs.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de argumentação e clareza.
  • Perfil proativo, autodidata, com senso de responsabilidade e alto comprometimento.
  • Capacidade de raciocínio estratégico, organização e gestão do tempo.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de processos (PJe, etc.) e softwares jurídicos.
O Que Oferecemos
  • Infraestrutura Completa : Disponibilizamos infraestrutura física moderna e tecnológica durante o horário comercial, com estações de trabalho equipadas e acesso a sistemas jurídicos essenciais para o desenvolvimento de suas atividades.
  • Apoio e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos suporte integral, treinamento contínuo e a oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em um ambiente colaborativo.
  • Mentoria e Plantão de Dúvidas : Acesso direto e plantão de dúvidas com os responsáveis e gestores do setor, garantindo que você tenha o apoio necessário para os desafios do dia a dia.
  • Remuneração Variável por Produtividade : Sua remuneração será composta por honorários associados à sua disponibilidade e produtividade, podendo variar entre R$ 2.000,00 e R$ 4.500,00, com potencial de crescimento conforme seu desempenho e engajamento.
Modelo de Trabalho

O modelo de trabalho exige uma presença inicialmente presencial em nosso escritório. Além disso, algumas atividades inerentes à função, como atendimentos a clientes e audiências, demandarão sua presença física. Valorizamos a flexibilidade na gestão da sua rotina de trabalho para a entrega das tarefas, mas a colaboração presencial faz parte do nosso ambiente.

Suas Obrigações como Associado(a)
  • Entregar as tarefas e demandas prontas e com a qualidade esperada, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Gerenciar sua rotina de trabalho de forma autônoma e organizada, otimizando o tempo e recursos disponíveis.
