title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search / recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.

We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8 / 01 / 25)

  • Do you live in Brazil and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
  • Can you type both fast and accurately?
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge and your income?
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a stable, long-term career related to HR?
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination / harassment complaint investigations?
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education / experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search / recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.

We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses :

Compensation :

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now) : The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are :

  • Gym membership support : $105 BRL
  • Private health insurance support : $265 BRL
  • Home office and phone / high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now) : The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are :

  • Gym membership support : $105 BRL
  • Private health insurance support : $265 BRL
  • Home office and phone / high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as :

  • High-performance bonus : When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California / USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.

Minimum / Required and Preferred Qualifications

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT :

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
  • A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST :

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
  • At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required. Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .

GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS :

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only) : The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only) : The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

How to Apply?2 Steps for a Complete Application

Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.

STEP #1 : Send an email with the following to :

  • Your current / updated resume in English.
  • A written statement about how you satisfy each of the required and preferred qualifications for the position.
  • Your job salary history for all jobs listed on your resume (including starting and ending salary for each job stated in COP) and any bonus opportunities that you had in each job.

STEP #2 :

We would like to evaluate your English verbal skills. Please send a video message via WhatsApp at and introduce yourself. (Please do not read. Speak naturally.)

You must provide all the requested information and complete all the steps listed above for your application to be complete.

Please send your complete application as soon as possible. We are coordinating interviews now!

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8 / 01 / 25)

  • Do you live in Brazil and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
  • Can you type both fast and accurately?
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge and your income?
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a stable, long-term career related to HR?
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination / harassment complaint investigations?
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education / experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search / recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.

We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses :

Compensation :

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now) : The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are :

  • Gym membership support : $105 BRL
  • Private health insurance support : $265 BRL
  • Home office and phone / high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now) : The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are :

  • Gym membership support : $105 BRL
  • Private health insurance support : $265 BRL
  • Home office and phone / high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as :

  • High-performance bonus : When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California / USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.

Minimum / Required and Preferred Qualifications

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT :

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
  • A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST :

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
  • At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required. Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

title: Organization Strategy Consultant
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Organization Strategy Consultant role at Accenture Argentina .

Join to apply for the Organization Strategy Consultant role at Accenture Argentina .

Búsqueda abierta para trabajar desde cualquier parte del país

Responsibilities
  • Transform the world's leading organizations by solving the most complex challenges they face. Design and execute innovative business solutions that help companies to succeed.
  • As part of our Strategy team we expect you to have fast track career. You will have a Career coach to succeed in your role within the Performance Achievement model.
  • In your role you are expected to work and partner with teams around the world serving global scale clients.
  • The Strategy team aspires to partner with C-suites on market disruption, broad corporate reinvention and leadership challenges.
  • Agile Operating Model: Helps clients strategize and design new, global operating models that integrate front to middle and back office activities across multiple processes and functions into meaningful end to end services with the customer experience at the center to deliver business outcomes.
  • Intelligent Business Services (IBS): Intelligent Business Services (IBS) combine an evolved operating model with a radical shift in company culture, mindset and its DNA to create business value by orchestrating human-centric, experience-led services enabled by Digital Hubs and delivered by an agile and capable workforce, in partnership with a strategically formed eco-system.
  • Zero-based Organization (ZBO): Zero Based Organization (ZBO) is designing an organization from a clean sheet by understanding the strategy for the organization and where they plan to head.
How will your everyday be?
  • Understand clients’ issues and challenges to develop hypotheses around possible solutions that contributes designing business and function operating models, that meet the company’s objectives. Incorporate future concepts such as future work, human + machine partnership, analytics, ecosystems and Gen AI.
  • Support clients across their business objectives and goals, including growth ambition (enterprise operating model), cost-cutting (global business services and shared services) and zero-based approaches.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Hi…

My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post.

Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Maybe no one will reply.

Maybe many will.

I just need one really good one!

So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You'll be working on a newsletter and more.

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!

We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts.

That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion).

Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)).

My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week.

All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done.

There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way.

We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with).

It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work.

The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows

USD 1,400 a month

25 hrs a week

Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses.

I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values.

We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself.

But the most important skill of all is: execution.

If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ***** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go!

Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ).

Thanks for reading this far.

Lena

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
The current opening is for the Brazilian office located in São Paulo / SP, but we are in a Home Office model (with no plans to return in person) and the work in the physical office is optional. Quem somos

A Artefact é uma provedora de serviços de dados de nova geração, especializada em consultoria de dados e marketing digital orientado a dados, dedicada a transformar dados em impacto nos negócios em toda a cadeia de valor das organizações. Temos orgulho de dizer que estamos vivenciando um crescimento exponencial.

Nossa ampla gama de soluções orientadas a dados em consultoria de dados e marketing digital é projetada para atender às necessidades específicas de nossos clientes, sempre concebida com uma abordagem centrada nos negócios e entregue com resultados tangíveis. Nossos serviços orientados a dados são construídos sobre a profunda expertise em IA que adquirimos com nossas mais de 300 marcas internacionais ao redor do mundo.

Temos mais de 1.000 funcionários em 20 escritórios em 17 países, focados em acelerar a transformação digital. Graças a uma combinação única de recursos da empresa : tecnologias de dados de ponta, metodologias ágeis de IA para entrega rápida e equipes coesas dos melhores consultores de negócios, analistas de dados, cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas digitais, todos dedicados a agregar valor a cada cliente.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) para liderar nossa estratégia de marketing no Brasil em um modelo de trabalho 100% remoto. O(A) profissional ideal é um(a) líder visionário(a), com sólida experiência em crescimento de marca (branding) e paixão por dados e IA, que prospere em ambientes dinâmicos e digitais.

Como CMO, você será a força motriz por trás da nossa marca, liderando uma equipe talentosa e distribuída geograficamente, e coordenando todas as frentes de marketing, desde a geração de leads e ecossistema de mídia até o fortalecimento da nossa comunidade exclusiva para líderes, o Data Circle.

Principais Desafios para o Próximo Ano :

Coordenar nossa estratégia de comunicação através de diferentes canais.

Fortalecer o branding da Artefact como líder em consultoria de IA e dados na América Latina.

Desenhar e executar a estratégia para colocar a marca Artefact nos locais corretos.

Desenvolver estratégias para o fortalecimento e crescimento do posicionamento da Artefact na América Latina como especialistas, líderes e referências no uso de IA na região.

Desenvolver e mentorar a equipe de marketing, fomentando uma cultura de alta performance, autonomia e inovação.

O que buscamos :

Experiência comprovada em posições de liderança em marketing, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia, consultoria ou agências de dados.

Histórico de sucesso na construção e crescimento de marcas.

Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente remoto.

Visão estratégica e habilidade para traduzir planos em ações concretas e mensuráveis.

O que oferecemos :
  • VR / VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros : Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso "Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;

Artefact é o lugar para estar : venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados

Progresso :

cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

Cultura :

junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar

Empreendedorismo :

você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Se você é um(a) líder de marketing pronto(a) para moldar o futuro de uma empresa em rápida expansão e valoriza a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto, queremos conhecer você! Junte-se a nós!

title: Médico Endocrinologista (Rqe)
description:
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

O QUE PROCURAMOS

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES
  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem‑informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
  • Formação Acadêmica :
    • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
    • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA
  • Certificações :
    • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM)
    • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia
    • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil)
  • Experiência :

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES

  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.

  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.

  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.

  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
The current opening is for the Brazilian office located in São Paulo / SP, but we are in a Home Office model (with no plans to return in person) and the work in the physical office is optional.

Quem somos

A Artefact é uma provedora de serviços de dados de nova geração, especializada em consultoria de dados e marketing digital orientado a dados, dedicada a transformar dados em impacto nos negócios em toda a cadeia de valor das organizações. Temos orgulho de dizer que estamos vivenciando um crescimento exponencial.

Nossa ampla gama de soluções orientadas a dados em consultoria de dados e marketing digital é projetada para atender às necessidades específicas de nossos clientes, sempre concebida com uma abordagem centrada nos negócios e entregue com resultados tangíveis. Nossos serviços orientados a dados são construídos sobre a profunda expertise em IA que adquirimos com nossas mais de 300 marcas internacionais ao redor do mundo.

Temos mais de 1.000 funcionários em 20 escritórios em 17 países, focados em acelerar a transformação digital. Graças a uma combinação única de recursos da empresa : tecnologias de dados de ponta, metodologias ágeis de IA para entrega rápida e equipes coesas dos melhores consultores de negócios, analistas de dados, cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas digitais, todos dedicados a agregar valor a cada cliente.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) para liderar nossa estratégia de marketing no Brasil em um modelo de trabalho 100% remoto. O(A) profissional ideal é um(a) líder visionário(a), com sólida experiência em crescimento de marca (branding) e paixão por dados e IA, que prospere em ambientes dinâmicos e digitais.

Como CMO, você será a força motriz por trás da nossa marca, liderando uma equipe talentosa e distribuída geograficamente, e coordenando todas as frentes de marketing, desde a geração de leads e ecossistema de mídia até o fortalecimento da nossa comunidade exclusiva para líderes, o Data Circle.

Principais Desafios para o Próximo Ano :
  • Coordenar nossa estratégia de comunicação através de diferentes canais.
  • Fortalecer o branding da Artefact como líder em consultoria de IA e dados na América Latina.
  • Desenhar e executar a estratégia para colocar a marca Artefact nos locais corretos.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para o fortalecimento e crescimento do posicionamento da Artefact na América Latina como especialistas, líderes e referências no uso de IA na região.
  • Desenvolver e mentorar a equipe de marketing, fomentando uma cultura de alta performance, autonomia e inovação.
O que buscamos :
  • Experiência comprovada em posições de liderança em marketing, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia, consultoria ou agências de dados.
  • Histórico de sucesso na construção e crescimento de marcas.
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente remoto.
  • Visão estratégica e habilidade para traduzir planos em ações concretas e mensuráveis.
O que oferecemos :
  • VR / VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros : Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós :
  • Artefact é o lugar para estar : venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
  • Progresso : cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
  • Cultura : junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
  • Empreendedorismo : você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Se você é um(a) líder de marketing pronto(a) para moldar o futuro de uma empresa em rápida expansão e valoriza a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto, queremos conhecer você! Junte-se a nós!

title: Médico (Endocrinologista - Consulta)
description:
Evyt Marketing Fantasy: Responsável por evoluir pacientes durante seu plantão, examinando-os, prescrevendo e ministrando tratamentos para diversas patologias, aplicando métodos da medicina comprovados cientificamente, seguindo o Plano Terapêutico definido.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Desempenhar suas atividades, respeitando os princípios do Código de Ética Médica e cumprindo as normas de trabalho designadas pelo regulamento interno do hospital;
  • Prestar cuidados ao paciente de acordo com a respectiva especialidade (cirurgião geral, clínica médica, neonatologia, obstetrícia, ortopedia, pediatria, psiquiatria, UCI, UTI adulto, UTI pediátrica) respeitando as orientações do médico assistente (Plano Terapêutico), e comunicar este sobre modificações importantes no quadro evolutivo do mesmo;
  • Prestar atendimento de urgência e emergência a todo paciente admitido nestas condições na unidade de Pronto Atendimento;
  • Prestar informações médicas ao paciente ou responsável legal, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário, em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente (registrar em prontuário médico);
  • Prestar informações médicas aos acompanhantes e familiares, sempre com autorização do paciente, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário registrando em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente (registrar em prontuário médico);
  • Efetuar o planejamento das admissões e altas (Plano Terapêutico) em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional e supervisionar os cuidados clínicos efetuados na unidade;
  • Admitir os pacientes na unidade, solicitando os documentos necessários e efetuando os devidos registros e controles internos, bem como programar e realizar as altas da unidade;
  • Examinar, evoluir e prescrever os pacientes (do pronto atendimento, da recuperação pós‑anestésica do centro cirúrgico, do centro obstétrico ou da enfermaria), checando exames e alterações fisiológicas e definindo condutas em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional, médico assistente e família/paciente;
  • Atender avaliações de urgência e emergência em outras áreas do hospital quando solicitado, o mais breve possível, registrando suas condutas e observações adequadamente, no prontuário médico do paciente;
  • Atender interconsultas em outras áreas do hospital quando solicitado, registrando suas observações adequadamente no prontuário médico do paciente;
  • Avaliar as solicitações de avaliação médica solicitado, registrando suas observações adequadamente no prontuário médico do paciente;
  • Solicitar vaga externa através da Central de Regulação de Vagas, sempre que o hospital não dispuser de vaga ou de serviço necessário. Nestes casos, informar seu coordenador;
  • Informar ao coordenador da equipe os casos com evolução prolongada, intercorrências não esperadas ou intercorrências sociais que ocorram durante o seu plantão;
  • Detectar e comunicar os órgãos competentes a existência de doadores, doenças de notificação compulsória e/ou casos de violência;
  • Participar de programas de qualidade da unidade, incluindo coleta de informações;
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas e administrativas para promover o aperfeiçoamento do serviço, bem como de eventos externo‑internos, quando solicitado;
  • Colaborar a participar na implementação de protocolos de assistência, pesquisa e ensino;
  • Interagir com os demais departamentos da instituição e áreas envolvidas no atendimento ao paciente, buscando o aprimoramento técnico e troca de experiências para melhoria constante das atividades da área;
  • Responder as solicitações do Serviço de Atenção ao Usuário referente à sua especialidade e atendimento;
  • Colaborar e participar do gerenciamento de risco da instituição;
  • Manter ao coordenador da unidade e da equipe informada sobre as atividades e problemas sob sua responsabilidade.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina;
  • Registro no Conselho ativo (CRM);
  • Conhecimento eminformática - nível usuário.

description:

Buscamos uma pessoa estrategista, comunicativa e com pensamento sistêmico, capaz de conectar áreas, estruturar informações complexas e traduzir soluções de produto em mensagens claras e aplicáveis para toda a companhia.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir o alinhamento entre times de Produto, Comercial, Growth e Marketing, construindo os artefatos e comunicações que sustentam o ciclo de vida dos produtos, desde o lançamento até a adoção e o sucesso do cliente.

Quais são os desafios:
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de comunicação interna sobre produtos, garantindo que todas as áreas entendam o posicionamento, as funcionalidades e os diferenciais das soluções;
  • Conduzir planosde lançamento e sustentação de produtos, organizando materiais, mensagens e rituais de alinhamento com áreas parceiras;
  • Produzir artefatos estratégicos (apresentações, guias de uso, roteiros de treinamento e conteúdos de enablement) para disseminar conhecimento sobre os produtos;
  • Conectar o timede produto a outras áreas, promovendo entendimento de proposta de valor, discurso comercial e jornada do cliente;
  • Conduzir pesquisas e escutas internas e com clientes, transformando feedbacks em melhorias e insights para o roadmap;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de adoção, engajamento e NPS, traduzindo dados em planos de ação e melhorias de comunicação.
O que você precisa conhecer:
  • Experiência em marketing de produto, comunicação de produto ou enablement;
  • Capacidade de organizar, sintetizar e comunicar informações técnicas de forma acessível e estratégica;
  • Vivência em lançamento e gestão de produtos digitais, com foco em experiência e adoção;
  • Habilidade de escrita e narrativa visual (para apresentações e materiais de suporte);
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de métricas de adoção, engajamento, churn e NPS, transformando dados em planos de comunicação e enablement;
  • Excelência em comunicação escrita e verbal, com atenção à clareza, consistência e tom de voz da marca.
Habilidades comportamentais:
  • Pensamento sistêmico e visão de negócio, com capacidade de conectar produto, cliente e estratégia;
  • Organização, senso de prioridade e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas;
  • Escuta ativa e facilidade em construir pontes entre áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Olhar crítico para detalhes e mentalidade de melhoria contínua;
  • Proatividade e autonomia para propor soluções e aprimorar processos de comunicação.
O que pode alavancar sua aplicação:
  • Experiência em fintechs, meios de pagamento ou infraestrutura financeira;
  • Certificações ou cursos em Product Marketing, Product Management, Growth ou UX Writing (como PM3, Reforge, Alura, CXL, etc.);
  • Noções de Product-Led Growth (PLG) e estratégias de adoção digital;
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de analytics e BI (Google Analytics, BI, Quicksight);
  • Conhecimento emdesign de experiência e comunicação orientada a jornada do cliente (CX);
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura e benchmark de referências globais de produto e comunicação.

Jornada Híbrida: nossa jornada de trabalho é híbrida, sendo 3x presenciais e 2x home office, além de contar com horário flexível, respeitando as particularidades de cada área.

Refeição e Alimentação: R$ 772,99.

Mobilidade: R$ 408,60 para o seu deslocamento podendo ser usado para todo serviço dentro dessa categoria (Uber, 99, recarregar cartão de transporte, estacionamento, dentre outros).

Além disso, mais R$ 508,00 para usar da forma que faça mais sentido para você entre refeição, alimentação ou mobilidade.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Bradesco: oferecemos caminhos para que você cuide da sua saúde com mais praticidade.

TotalPass: plataforma com mais de 250 modalidades de treino disponíveis em milhares de academias credenciadas.

Vittude: agendamento de consultas psicológicas com o profissional de sua preferência, com desconto de 40% em todas as sessões.

Seguro de Vida: oferecemos soluções que ajudam você a lidar melhor com os desafios do dia a dia.

Café da manhã: todos os dias para nossos(as) iuguers começarem o dia bem.

Frutas: todos os dias no escritório.

Minimercado: praticidade no dia a dia opções de snacks, marmitinhas e bebidas para todos os gostos.

Auxílio-creche: para mamães e papais.

Licença-maternidade: estendida para 180 dias.

Licença-parental: estendida para 30 dias.

Incentivo de Curto Prazo : de acordo com atingimento de metas e avaliação de desempenho individual.

Day off: no mês do seu aniversário.

iu+go: Programa de gestão de performance semestral, com acompanhamento do seu PDI.

iugu academy: é um ambiente de aprendizagem criado pela própria iugu! Por meio dela, você terá acesso os conteúdos regulatórios e trilhas específicas.

Convênios: parcerias com instituições de ensino incríveis – como escolas de idiomas e faculdades (descontos exclusivos para iuguers e seus dependentes).

Outros diferenciais:
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído, com espírito de equipe e pessoas talentosas;
  • Autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias;
  • Ambiente que valoriza feedbacks e 1:1 constantes.

Aqui diversidade importa! Valorizamos as diferenças, pluralidades de raça, cor, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, orientações sexuais ou de idade, pois acreditamos na importância de compartilhar ideias e pontos de vistas distintos.

Prazer, somos a iugu

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que oferece o ecossistema mais completo e flexível de infraestrutura financeira. Oferecemos soluções seguras, escaláveis e personalizáveis para grandes operações dos mais diversos segmentos, como educação, saúde, SaaS e iGaming. Desde sua fundação em 2012, a iugu conquistou importantes marcos: temos entre nossos investidores a Grupo Goldman Sachs;
somos a 25ª Instituiçãode Pagamento licenciada pelo Banco Central;
e adquirimos o selo B Corp — reconhecimento internacional concedido a empresas que são referência em impacto positivo no mundo.

Missão:

fortalecer empresas para expandirem seus negócios com soluções tecnológicas escaláveis, seguras e flexíveis.

Visão:

ser a melhor empresa de tecnologia de soluções modulares, que impulsiona o crescimento dos clientes de maneira confiável.

  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.

- Organização, atenção a detalhes e proatividade.

- Perfil comunicativo, educado e com boa postura profissional.

- Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe e interesse genuíno em aprender.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills;
    ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws;
    must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Recife / Brasilia

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in for T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main ResponsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About YouExperience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred

Language: Advanced English required.

Why Should You Choose Us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people's lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil's largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

Progress wouldn't be possible without people;
people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and plugging! The email marketing channel is a strong focus for us, and if you get a thrill from optimizing flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimizing flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness. Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you ‑ running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork.

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena.

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.
